sections.kicker: Prepared for ARX Hotel by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a guest planning a winter week would. Here is what stood out.
sections.thesis: ARX Hotel looks like a ski hotel, and the restaurant you are proud of is nowhere on the first screen.
sections.keep: The hero film and the tall ARX HOTEL wordmark. It looks confident and nothing like the chalets next door.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.area: A skier on a groomed slope fills the whole first screen
pins.what: The first screen sells the mountain.
pins.why: Every hotel in Schladming can show a skier, so the film does not say why stay at ARX.
pins.how: Let the first screen show what only ARX has: the table.
pins.label: Your hero
pins.cost: Guests compare you to every ski hotel on price and location.

pins.area: ARX HOTEL wordmark in the lower left corner
pins.what: The wordmark says hotel, not restaurant concept.
pins.why: If the food is the concept, the name and the line under it have to carry it.
pins.how: Add one line under ARX HOTEL that names the kitchen.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: Half board reads as a meal plan instead of the reason to book.

pins.what: Your place is your best ingredient.
pins.why: Rohrmoos and Schladming give the kitchen a story about the valley that no city restaurant has.
pins.how: Tie the food to the place, and let half board become an experience of the valley.
pins.label: Your place
pins.cost: The local story stays a caption.

sections.intro: You said people do not get the concept fast enough, and that the fine dining half board feels old fashioned. I spent some time on your site. Here is where the concept gets lost.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on ARX Hotel's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
